A suit and tie carries strong social symbolism: authority, competence, and attention to detail. When you wear them, you're not just dressing your body; you're dressing your mindset.

It also creates a kind of "armor" or ritual that signals to yourself, "I'm prepared, I'm capable." That physical transformation—straightening a tie, buttoning a jacket—can be a grounding moment before stepping into a challenging situation.
